speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if the itching is worse at night?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that history; your age, ulcerative colitis, sexual history, and the 2-month duration of fatigue and pruritus are concerning for Hepatitis C or an infiltrative liver process. Given your sexual risk factors, have you experienced any jaundice, dark urine, or weight loss recently?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel, HCV_Antibody, HBsAg, HIV_Ag/Ab
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_US

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver_Function_Panel: Bilirubin_Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct 0.9 mg/dL, Alkaline_Phosphatase 460 U/L, AST 75 U/L, ALT 78 U/L; HCV_Antibody: Not Reported; HBsAg: Not Reported; HIV_Ag/Ab: Not Reported; Abdominal_US: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, Ulcerative Colitis Social history: Sexually active with inconsistent condom use

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, diarrhea, joint pain, or recent travel. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). While the patient's history of ulcerative colitis and sexual activity raises concerns for autoimmune overlap or viral hepatitis, the denial of fever, travel, and other infectious symptoms makes pneumonia highly unlikely. The clinical picture of fatigue and pruritus in a patient with autoimmune disease is classic for PBC. I will proceed with specific serology and imaging to confirm.

REQUEST TEST: AMA_Microsome_Antibodies, Anti_Mitochondrial_Antibody
REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel (specifically Alkaline Phosphatase and Bilirubin)
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_US
